title: F9 rollback proof, F10a confirmation, F10b atomic depreciation post
statusReason: Code and static/simulated verification only. No Postgres or node_modules here: typecheck, build and every DB test (including the new F9 rollback and F10b tests, and the existing ledger-invariants suite that covers the postJournal refactor) did not run.
supersedes: fin-wp4-evidence.json where it lists F10b as OPEN and says F9 has no rollback test.

f9.state: already fixed in WP-4 (delete+insert in one transaction per generator); this step adds rollback proof
tests: amortization regenerate with an invalid start date throws after the delete and the previous rows must survive

f10a.state: already fixed in WP-4 (conditional claim status <> 'posted'); unchanged here
f10a.test: wp4-use-cases.db.test.ts F10a (4 concurrent posts, one journal)

f10b.change: claim + journal + asset totalValue update are one transaction; journal failure rolls back and the route returns 500 (explicit journal_failed outcome); other errors roll back and propagate
f10b.refactor: ledger/journal.ts postJournal split into prepareJournal + insertJournal; new postJournalInTx(tx,...). Check: of the old lines, only 5 structural ones changed (signature wrapper, db.transaction wrapper, a comment); every statement present.

f10b.publicSurface: lib/finance-accounting.ts shim unchanged (34 symbols); postDepreciationJournal unchanged in behaviour

newObservation.summary: Express 4, no async error wrapper or unhandledRejection handler found; a thrown error in any async handler is an unhandled rejection. App-wide, not fixed.

commands.mutation: swallowing the journal failure again makes it fail; restored 8/8
commands.proves: ordering (claim, journal, asset update), rollback on false and on throw, outcome mapping, lost-claim path, early returns; does NOT prove database atomicity
